mapper.select: SELECT e.ENTRY_NO AS entryNo, e.PLAN_NO AS planNo, p.PLAN_TITLE AS planTitle, e.USER_NO AS userNo, TO_CHAR(e.MEAL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mealDate, e.MEAL_TYPE AS mealType, e.ENTRY_TITLE AS entryTitle, e.ENTRY_DESCRIPTION AS entryDescription, e.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, e.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, e.SERVINGS AS servings, e.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder, COALESCE(e.IMAGE_URL, r.IMAGE_URL) AS imageUrl FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY e LEFT JOIN OFT_MEAL_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_NO = e.PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_RECIPE r ON r.RECIPE_NO = e.RECIPE_NO WHERE e.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND e.MEAL_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY e.MEAL_DATE ASC, CASE e.MEAL_TYPE WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN 2 WHEN 'DINNER' THEN 3 WHEN 'SNACK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC, e.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, e.ENTRY_NO ASC

SELECT i.ENTRY_INGREDIENT_NO AS entryIngredientNo, i.ENTRY_NO AS entryNo, i.INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, i.AMOUNT_VALUE AS amountValue, i.UNIT AS unit, i.AMOUNT_TEXT AS amountText, i.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY_INGREDIENT i JOIN OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY e ON e.ENTRY_NO = i.ENTRY_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = i.PRODUCT_NO WHERE e.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND e.MEAL_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY i.ENTRY_NO ASC, i.ENTRY_INGREDIENT_NO ASC

SELECT e.ENTRY_NO AS entryNo, e.PLAN_NO AS planNo, p.PLAN_TITLE AS planTitle, e.USER_NO AS userNo, TO_CHAR(e.MEAL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mealDate, e.MEAL_TYPE AS mealType, e.ENTRY_TITLE AS entryTitle, e.ENTRY_DESCRIPTION AS entryDescription, e.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, e.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, e.SERVINGS AS servings, e.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder, COALESCE(e.IMAGE_URL, r.IMAGE_URL) AS imageUrl FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY e LEFT JOIN OFT_MEAL_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_NO = e.PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_RECIPE r ON r.RECIPE_NO = e.RECIPE_NO WHERE e.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND e.ENTRY_NO = #{entryNo}

SELECT i.ENTRY_INGREDIENT_NO AS entryIngredientNo, i.ENTRY_NO AS entryNo, i.INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, i.AMOUNT_VALUE AS amountValue, i.UNIT AS unit, i.AMOUNT_TEXT AS amountText, i.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY_INGREDIENT i LEFT JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = i.PRODUCT_NO WHERE i.ENTRY_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY i.ENTRY_INGREDIENT_NO ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO OFT_MEAL_PLAN ( USER_NO, PLAN_TITLE, SOURCE_TYPE, REQUEST_TEXT, PLAN_SUMMARY, START_DATE, END_DATE, AI_RESPONSE_ID ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{planTitle}, #{sourceType}, #{requestText}, #{planSummary}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{aiResponseId} )
SELECT PLAN_NO FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND PLAN_TITLE = #{planTitle} AND SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType} AND START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ( (#{aiResponseId} IS NULL AND AI_RESPONSE_ID IS NULL) OR AI_RESPONSE_ID = #{aiResponseId} ) ORDER BY PLAN_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

INSERT INTO OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY ( PLAN_NO, USER_NO, MEAL_DATE, MEAL_TYPE, ENTRY_TITLE, ENTRY_DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_TYPE, RECIPE_NO, SERVINGS, DISPLAY_ORDER, IMAGE_URL ) VALUES ( #{planNo}, #{userNo}, TO_DATE(#{mealDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{mealType}, #{entryTitle}, #{entryDescription}, #{sourceType}, #{recipeNo}, #{servings}, #{displayOrder}, #{imageUrl} )
SELECT ENTRY_NO FROM OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND MEAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{mealDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MEAL_TYPE = #{mealType} AND ENTRY_TITLE = #{entryTitle} AND DISPLAY_ORDER = #{displayOrder} AND ( (#{planNo} IS NULL AND PLAN_NO IS NULL) OR PLAN_NO = #{planNo} ) ORDER BY ENTRY_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

INSERT INTO OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY_INGREDIENT ( ENTRY_NO, INGREDIENT_NAME, AMOUNT_VALUE, UNIT, AMOUNT_TEXT, PRODUCT_NO ) VALUES ( #{entryNo}, #{ingredientName}, #{amountValue}, #{unit}, #{amountText}, #{productNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_MEAL_PLAN_ENTRY SET MEAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{mealDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MEAL_TYPE = #{mealType}, ENTRY_TITLE = #{entryTitle}, ENTRY_DESCRIPTION = #{entryDescription}, SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType}, RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo}, SERVINGS = #{servings}, DISPLAY_ORDER = #{displayOrder}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl} WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND ENTRY_NO = #{entryNo}
